combat_classes.line_combat: Eligible for normal assault/contact according to position, formation and weapon reach.
combat_classes.combat_support: Engineers, sappers, scouts and similar military specialists primarily contribute their specialist capacity. Scouts are military reconnaissance troops, not couriers. Combat-support specialists do not add ordinary line frontage unless explicitly committed or physically caught in contact.
combat_classes.service_support: Logistics, signals and other explicitly military service specialists are military support units. They are targetable and casualty-bearing but do not add default offensive frontage. Medical personnel and couriers are excluded from this class.
combat_classes.noncombat_support: Students, civilian laborers, dependents, medical personnel, couriers, runners and camp followers are noncombat populations unless lawfully mobilized into a real non-medical, non-courier troop type with training, equipment and authority.

capacities.medical: treatment_and_evacuation_capacity = available civilian medical personnel x Medicine/qualification x medical stores x treatment time x facility/camp quality. Civilian medical personnel never create military units or command slots; they may suffer casualties only when their camp, treatment site or evacuation chain is materially exposed.
capacities.logistics: throughput = fit logistics personnel x transport capacity x route quality x stores available x handling time x security.
capacities.signal: order_relay_capacity and delay depend on fit signal personnel, relay equipment, visibility/range, terrain, disruption and command load.
capacities.engineering: engineering throughput depends on fit engineers/sappers, Engineering skill, tools/materials, work time, site access and enemy interference.

camp_followers: Civilian camp followers, dependents, laborers, physicians, healers, medical orderlies, stretcher crews, couriers and administrative runners are supply-consuming noncombat population owners, not military units and consume no military unit command slots. Armed train guards are separate homogeneous guard units; military scouts remain separate reconnaissance troops.
lightweight_service_state: A cold military service unit may store support capability plus minimal physical/self-defense state rather than a full line-combat skill array. Medical support and courier work never use this military-unit representation and instead resolve from civilian population/support or administrative process state.
casualty_rule: Military support casualties reduce military support capacity. Civilian medical and courier casualties resolve only through valid exposure of their camp, treatment site, evacuation chain, transport route or administrative movement; they do not inherit frontline casualty exposure merely because they support an army.
